notes.title: Driver4VR Update 5.13.0.0 - PSMoveService to PSMoveServiceEx Update
notes.content:
Hello,

Since PSMoveService has not been updated for a while, Driver4VR has now been updated to use PSMoveServiceEx. This doesn't change much of the instructions; the main changes are related to the installation process. The UI is also very similar but has many great new features. PSMoveServiceEx is a great enhancement to PSMoveService, and I am thankful to the developer, Timocop, for that.

Here is a short info about the changes being made: [url=https://support.driver4vr.com/faq/psmoveserviceex-setup-and-updating-psmoveservice-to-psmoveserviceex/]Updating PSMoveService to PSMoveServiceEx[/url]..

In case of problems, please contact me via the [url=https://support.driver4vr.com/]support page[/url].

Enjoy :)

tags.feature: Since PSMoveService has not been updated for a while, Driver4VR has now been updated to use PSMoveServiceEx.
The UI is also very similar but has many great new features.

notes.title: Driver4VR Update 5.12.4 - Introducing Puppeteer (Kinetic DLC)
notes.content:
Puppeteer is a new upgrade to full-body pose estimation! It lets you control your virtual character's full body moves using VR controllers, giving you more freedom to express yourself in the virtual world. 
Just move your hands with the controllers while holding the grip button, and your character follows suit, making your gaming experience more immersive and fun than ever before.

To enable/disable Puppeteer mode hold controllers above the head and hold grip for a while.

Now with Puppeteer mode when you hold grip, you start controlling your feet. That is all :) Check out the below video on how it works in action.

[previewyoutube=ECH0vVU-bDs;full][/previewyoutube]

tags.feature: Puppeteer is a new upgrade to full-body pose estimation! It lets you control your virtual character's full body moves using VR controllers, giving you more freedom to express yourself in the virtual world.

notes.title: Driver4VR Beta 5.7
notes.content:
Welcome to Beta tests of new upcoming feature: Body Tracking with Webcam using Deep Learning.
You need only a webcam now to emulate body tracking for VRChat, NeosVR, etc.
In short, I'd say it is not as precise as Kinect but can detect a broader range of poses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40597360/552dcb5ea6493754a6db321844512c4479292f52.png[/img]
To use webcam body tracking:

1. Select Body Tracking: [i]Webcam / Deep Learning (Beta)[/i]. Click [I]Configuration[/I].
2. Start Driver4VR. You should see the webcam image in the preview. 
You should see trackers floating around below your headset but most likely they will point in the wrong direction.
3. Press [i]Calibrate[/i]. Look down and rotate slightly head left and right until the tracker direction is not aligned with your pose.

That should be all :)

There are more things to determine but there were many requests to make beta as early as possible so here it is. I will be definitively searching for tips on how to make it work best possible way, like how to make webcam work on 25-30fps instead of only 15. What background is best for tracking, camera placement, etc. But from my observations, it works nicely out of the box!

Please join [url=https://discord.gg/Bks9YyX]Discord[/url] on #webcam-body-tracking channel for discussion!

Best regards,
Greg

tags.feature: Welcome to Beta tests of new upcoming feature: Body Tracking with Webcam using Deep Learning.
You need only a webcam now to emulate body tracking for VRChat, NeosVR, etc.

notes.title: Driver4VR 5.7.0.0
notes.content:
In this release, Driver4VR is adding a new feature that allows the use of Oculus Rift CV1 Touch Controllers as body trackers. Another new feature is IMU Tracker, a concept to well-known owoTracker but instead of a phone, it will work with devices supported by Driver4VR like PS Move, Joy-Con, etc.

For body tracking with Rift CV1, you need to use it together with other VR setups. Details in the video below:
[previewyoutube=gwuQrF8-R-4;full][/previewyoutube]

Other fixes:
- ability to reconnect Xbox Controller
- fix for crashing Camera Markers when more than one PS Eye was connected.
- added hip tracking for Camera Markers.

notes.title: Driver4VR 5.6.14.0 - Small update
notes.content:
Driver4VR has been updated to version 5.6.14.0.

This build contains the following changes:
